name: output-cap
description: Bash results over 150 lines reach Claude as their first and last lines with a note of how many lines were cut, so a long log or test run does not flood the context.

max_lines.title: Max Bash output lines
max_lines.description: stdout and stderr together keep at most this many lines (first and last of each long stream), with a note of the lines cut. Errored results too.
